meta.phase: PHASE 11 — deep variational quantum Monte Carlo & continuous neural wavefunctions
meta.engine: PyTorch FermiPauliNet (FermiNet/PauliNet family), float64, vectorized walkers
meta.walker_policy: Metropolis-Hastings Gaussian random walk in 3N space, adaptive step locked to 45-55% acceptance
meta.kinetic: exact reverse-mode AD Laplacian of ln|Psi| (one-hot Hessian-trace contraction), FD-cross-validated
meta.gradient: dE/dtheta = 2 E[(E_L-<E>) dlnPsi/dtheta] (exact REINFORCE estimator), 5-sigma E_L clip + global-norm clip 5, Adam + cosine
meta.references: Psi4 1.11 DETCI aug-cc-pV{T,Q}Z CBS (HF/CCSD(T)/FCI); Kolos-Wolniewicz & Pekeris exact limits as invariants
